Wade Kearney is a fictional character created by American author Ron Shiflet for his Cthulhu Mythos stories. He made his debut appearance in the short story "Unfinished Business" in July 2006.

page.overview:
Who is Wade Kearney?

Wade Kearney is a fictional character created by American author Ron Shiflet for his Cthulhu Mythos stories. He made his debut appearance in the short story "Unfinished Business" in July 2006.

Kearney is a tough, hard-drinking private detective based in Arkham, Massachusetts. Despite having no desire to look into such matters, many of the cases which cross his desk involve supernatural elements: as a result, he is occasionally sought out by clients who have heard of his experience with occult investigations.

In addition to his detective services, Kearney has also been known to provide security services, although he appears somewhat reluctant to engage in such employment.

In his story notes for the 2017 edition of Looking for Darla: Stories of Mythos Noir, creator Ron Shiflet states that "The truth is that there was an ongoing mental tussle at the time as to whether I should focus on [Bill] Sweetan or Wade Kearney as an ongoing character in my fiction. They are pretty much the same person but I eventually seemed to settle on Kearney."
